We should have a recommendation for referencing facts and events in the series by book and chapter. Obviously there would be a big job to go through the whole wiki and retroactively apply it, but a policy of making an attempt to locate what chapter something is said would be useful in general in going forward. Most can be found on Encyclopaedia WoT and verified if needed. I'm adding things as I go through listening to the audiobooks and it seems handy to apply that to my own edits as I go.
